phase2_verification.verified_at: Phase 2 — local load + forward pass on xlm-roberta-base checkpoint confirmed; 3-class output (STANCE_CRIT/NEUT/SUPP) produced at correct indices. STANCE_CRIT_SARC was merged into STANCE_CRIT during Phase 1 taxonomy correction.

taxonomy_note: num_labels was incorrectly 5 in the original project config. Corrected to 3 in Phase 5 to match the actual checkpoint (which uses the 3-class merged taxonomy from Phase 1). The HF checkpoint config.json in checkpoints/best_model/ has the authoritative value and was NOT modified.
